meta.method: Consumer Affairs Victoria public register name search Name=Mallacoota (pages 1–2), IaDetails pages via full search-result URLs, plus official org sites, ACNC/ABN, East Gippsland Shire, Lions Australia, Pony Club Victoria, Life Saving Victoria, Tennis Australia, and local news. Private Facebook was not scraped. Contacts used only if seen on an official or clearly public organisational page. Unverified fields are null and listed in uncertain[].

registered.legal_name: Friends Of Mallacoota Incorporated
registered.what_they_do: Community conservation group preserving biodiversity around Mallacoota and Gabo Island through bushcare/coastcare, town clean-ups, a native plant nursery/botanic garden, bird monitoring (including Hooded Plover), and environmental advocacy.

social.note: Nursery page cited on official Botanic Garden/Nursery program page.

uncertain: No public street/meeting address on current official site. A 2016 Environment Victoria page listed meeting places and a landline; not used as current contacts.
registered.still_operating_evidence: Official website copyright 2026; CAV last AGM 25 Oct 2025, 147 members; ACNC charity.

registered.legal_name: LIONS CLUB OF MALLACOOTA & DISTRICT INC.
registered.what_they_do: Local Lions service club in District 201V3. A September 2024 district newsletter recorded a district governor visit and described bushfire-recovery work including a recovery walk at the golf club.
uncertain: No dedicated club website, phone or PO Box verified. Email is from the Lions Australia club finder. Unverified third-party emails/PO Boxes were not used.
registered.still_operating_evidence: CAV last AGM 9 Sep 2025 (15 members); listed on Lions Clubs Australia finder; 2024 district newsletter describes an active visit.

registered.legal_name: MALLACOOTA & DISTRICT CAR & BIKE CLUB INCORPORATED
registered.what_they_do: Social club for local car and bike enthusiasts in isolated Far East Gippsland so members need not travel to other districts (CAV purpose extract).

cav.purpose_on_register: Being so isolated in far east Gippsland from any other car club many car enthusiasts want to start their own club here in the town.

uncertain: No official website, phone, email, address or public Facebook page found.
registered.still_operating_evidence: CAV last AGM 6 Nov 2025 with 38 members.

registered.legal_name: MALLACOOTA & DISTRICT TOOL LIBRARY INC.
registered.what_they_do: Volunteer community tool library (300+ tools) for gardening, home maintenance and DIY, established 2021 to support bushfire recovery. Open Thursdays 9–11am and Saturdays 10am–12 noon.
registered.address: 96 Bastion Point Road, Mallacoota VIC 3892 (postal: PO Box 466, Mallacoota VIC 3892)
uncertain: CAV last AGM is 3 Dec 2024 (not 2025). No public phone on official site.
registered.still_operating_evidence: Official website copyright 2026 with opening hours; CAV registered, 114 members.

registered.legal_name: MALLACOOTA AND DISTRICT ANGLING CLUB INC.
registered.what_they_do: Local angling club. A live Square membership/checkout site exists under the club name; purpose not published on CAV beyond the rules.
uncertain: Club site did not publish phone, email or street address in fetched HTML. A third-party directory listed 12 Greer St and 0493 304 416; not used.
registered.still_operating_evidence: CAV last AGM 8 Aug 2025 (20 members); live club website.

registered.legal_name: MALLACOOTA AND DISTRICT BUSINESS AND TOURISM ASSOCIATION INC.
registered.common_name: Mallacoota District Business and Tourism Association (MDBTA)
registered.what_they_do: Business and tourism association. Visit Mallacoota publicly attributes its campaign/website to this association. MADRA's recovery plan names MDBTA as the lead body for local business and tourism initiatives.

registered.still_operating_evidence: CAV last AGM 18 Nov 2025 (50 members); ABN active; Visit Mallacoota live.

registered.legal_name: Mallacoota And District Historical Society Incorporated
registered.what_they_do: Researches and collects local history (since 1974) and operates the Mallacoota WWII Bunker Museum and the Genoa School Museum. Volunteer-run.
registered.address: Bunker Museum: Airport Road, Mallacoota VIC 3892 (via Betka Road, about 4.5 km from town). Postal: The Secretary, PO Box 151, Mallacoota VIC 3892. Genoa School Museum: Princes Highway, Genoa (open 2–4 pm Thursdays).
uncertain: Official bunker contact page obfuscates email in HTML. secretarymallacootadhs@gmail.com is from the RHSV public directory; that RHSV page timed out on a later fetch. RHSV also listed older phones 03 5158 0369 and 0459 437 474; official site currently publishes 0474 858 584.
registered.still_operating_evidence: Official museum website with current opening times; CAV last AGM 7 Dec 2025 (66 members).

registered.legal_name: MALLACOOTA AND DISTRICT KIDS INC.
registered.what_they_do: Supports and advocates for children (emphasis 0–12 years) in Mallacoota and surrounding districts (CAV purpose). Publicly credited with the preschool Parent Advisory Group for a mural at Mallacoota Preschool.

cav.purpose_on_register: support and advocate for the needs and interests of children (with an emphasis on children aged 0-12 years)

uncertain: No dedicated website, phone, email or Facebook found. Not the same entity as Y Kinders / Mallacoota Preschool.
registered.still_operating_evidence: CAV last AGM 19 Nov 2025 (29 members); named in a Y Kinders article.

registered.legal_name: Mallacoota And District Recovery Association Incorporated
registered.what_they_do: Community-led disaster recovery association formed after the 2019–20 Black Summer bushfires. Advocates for Mallacoota and district and channels funding. June 2025 news proposed a smaller 'MADRA on Standby' committee while remaining incorporated with ACNC/DGR status.
registered.address: Postal: Locked Bag 1005, Post Office, Mallacoota VIC 3892
uncertain: No public phone on current MADRA site. June 2025 news describes a shift to a standby/minimal committee.
registered.still_operating_evidence: Official website with 2025 news; CAV last AGM 13 Nov 2025 (812 members); ACNC charity.

registered.legal_name: MALLACOOTA AND DISTRICT UNIVERSITY OF THE THIRD AGE (U3A) INC.
registered.what_they_do: Volunteer lifelong-learning group for Mallacoota, Genoa, Gipsy Point and nearby localities: monthly presentations (usually first Friday 2pm at Mallacoota Community Clubrooms), weekly current-affairs afternoon tea, mah-jong, astronomy, and a bi-monthly newsletter.
registered.address: Postal/office: P.O. Box 339, Mallacoota VIC 3892. Presentations: Mallacoota Community Clubrooms. Tuesday discussions: church meeting room, Allan Drive (during school term).

extra.membership_secretary_phone: 0403 807 124 (Caroline Jones; About Us page, not labelled as general enquiry)

uncertain: Contact/membership pages have email fields that rendered empty (likely JS-protected). No public email captured.

Operational volunteer marine rescue in town is Australian Volunteer Coast Guard flotilla VF15 (not this CAV entity).

registered.still_operating_evidence: Incorporated 8 Oct 2024; own site live as consultation. CAV shows no last AGM. Not operational as a rescue unit.
